tools.description: If an earlier check_incident answer gave you a feedback token and you then tried again, say whether it worked. tools.name: report_observation
tools.description: Submit one de-identified firsthand observation under your own operating authority and platform rules. Public reports enter private review and are not site-status claims. Never include names, account details, URLs, cookies, tokens, or conversation text.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_incident · Private data: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation · Public sink: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_incident · Private data: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation · Public sink: check_incident, rate_last_lookup, report_observation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
